claims.sentence: For first-year bachelor’s students enrolled in full-time education on budgetary funds, the university issues an order of admission
The university also provides information on admission for these students

Additionally, the university provides information on admission for first-year bachelor’s students on main places within the controlled intake numbers for budgetary funds, for applicants placed as a result of entrance examinations
For first-year master’s students enrolled in full-time education on budgetary funds, the university issues an order of admission
The university also provides information on admission for these students
